# Obtrace — Full LLM Reference

> Observability platform with AI-powered root cause analysis, autofix, and multi-language SDK support.

## Architecture

Obtrace follows a streaming architecture:

```
SDKs / OTLP sources → ingest-edge (auth, rate-limit, billing gate, PII scrub)
  → Redpanda/Kafka (TLS, 3-broker)
  → Workers (otlp, replay, recipes, incident-engine, incident-actions)
  → Storage (ClickHouse, Postgres, MinIO, Redis)
  → Serving (query-gateway, control-plane-api, replay-proxy, ai-service)
  → Frontend
```

### Storage Roles

- **ClickHouse**: Analytical telemetry (logs, traces, metrics)
- **Postgres**: Auth, projects, dashboards, incidents, runtime config, billing
- **MinIO/S3**: Replay session blob chunks
- **Redis**: Ephemeral cache/locks, billing gate state

### Data Scoping

All data is scoped by `tenant_id / project_id / app_id / env`.

## SDKs

### Node.js / Bun

```bash
npm i @obtrace/sdk
```

```ts
import { initNodeSDK } from "@obtrace/sdk/node";

initNodeSDK({
  apiKey: process.env.OBTRACE_API_KEY,
  serviceName: "my-service",
});
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/node-bun

### Browser (Vite/React/Vue)

```bash
npm i @obtrace/browser
```

```ts
import { initBrowserSDK } from "@obtrace/browser";

initBrowserSDK({
  apiKey: import.meta.env.VITE_OBTRACE_PUBLIC_KEY,
  serviceName: "my-web",
});
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/browser

### Python

```bash
pip install obtrace-sdk-python
```

```python
from obtrace_sdk import ObtraceClient, ObtraceConfig

client = ObtraceClient(ObtraceConfig(
    api_key=os.environ["OBTRACE_API_KEY"],
    service_name="my-service",
))
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/python

### Go

```bash
go get github.com/obtraceai/obtrace-sdk-go
```

```go
client := obtrace.NewClient(obtrace.Config{
    APIKey:      os.Getenv("OBTRACE_API_KEY"),
    ServiceName: "my-service",
})
defer client.Shutdown(ctx)
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/go

### Java

```java
var client = new ObtraceClient(ObtraceConfig.builder()
    .apiKey(System.getenv("OBTRACE_API_KEY"))
    .serviceName("my-service")
    .build());
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/java

### .NET

```bash
dotnet add package Obtrace.Sdk
```

```csharp
builder.Services.AddObtrace(new ObtraceConfig
{
    ApiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OBTRACE_API_KEY"),
    ServiceName = "my-service",
});
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/dotnet

### PHP / Laravel

```bash
composer require obtrace/sdk
```

```php
$client = new ObtraceClient(new ObtraceConfig(
    apiKey: getenv('OBTRACE_API_KEY'),
    serviceName: 'my-service',
));
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/php

### Ruby / Rails

```bash
bundle add obtrace
```

```ruby
OBTRACE = ObtraceSDK::Client.new(ObtraceSDK::Config.new(
    api_key: ENV["OBTRACE_API_KEY"],
    service_name: "my-service",
))
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/sdks/ruby

## Managed Agents

### Database Agent

Monitors PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis databases.

```bash
docker run -d \
  -e OBTRACE_API_KEY=obt_live_xxxxx \
  -e DB_CONNECTIONS='[{"type":"postgres","dsn":"postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db","name":"my-db"}]' \
  ghcr.io/obtraceai/db-agent
```

Metrics: active connections, query duration (P50/P95/P99), slow queries, lock contention, table sizes, index usage.

### Infrastructure Agent

Monitors host/container metrics.

```bash
docker run -d --privileged --pid=host --network=host \
  -e OBTRACE_API_KEY=obt_live_xxxxx \
  -v /proc:/host/proc:ro -v /sys:/host/sys:ro \
  ghcr.io/obtraceai/infra-agent
```

Metrics: CPU, memory, disk, network, container stats.

### Supabase Agent (Managed)

Connects via OAuth to your Supabase account. No SDK installation required.

**Setup:**
1. Go to Account > Supabase in the Obtrace dashboard
2. Click "Connect Supabase" to authenticate via OAuth
3. Discover and enable projects to monitor
4. Toggle collectors: Database, Edge Functions, Auth, Storage, Realtime

**Metrics emitted:**
- `supabase.project.health` — project health gauge
- `db.postgres.*` — database metrics (compatible with DB Agent)
- `supabase.edge_function.invocations`, `.errors`, `.latency_ms`
- `supabase.auth.monthly_active_users`, `.signins`, `.signups`
- `supabase.storage.size_bytes`, `.object_count`
- `supabase.realtime.connections`, `.messages`

**Auto-instrumentation:** Optionally injects OBTRACE_API_KEY as a secret into Supabase projects so Edge Functions can use the SDK automatically.

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/platforms/supabase

## Platform Integrations

### Next.js

```bash
npm i @obtrace/sdk @obtrace/browser
```

Server-side instrumentation.ts + client-side providers.tsx pattern.
Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/projects/nextjs

### Vercel

Add `OBTRACE_API_KEY` as env var, use Node SDK in `instrumentation.ts`.
Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/platforms/vercel

### Cloudflare Workers

Use Node SDK with `env.OBTRACE_API_KEY` from wrangler.toml vars.
Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/integrations/cloudflare

### Railway

Add `OBTRACE_API_KEY` via Railway dashboard or CLI, use Node SDK.
Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/platforms/railway

### Kubernetes (obtrace-zero)

Zero-code cluster-wide auto-instrumentation.

```bash
obtrace-zero install --api-key=YOUR_KEY --service-name=my-cluster
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/obtrace-zero

## AI Capabilities

- **Chat-to-query**: Natural language queries over telemetry data
- **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**: AI analyzes error patterns and identifies probable root causes
- **Autofix**: Generates code fixes and opens pull requests automatically
- **Incident Detection**: Pattern-based incident detection with configurable thresholds
- **Fix Outcome Tracking**: Tracks whether AI-generated fixes resolved the issue (error → fix → result graph)

AI providers: DeepSeek (router/reasoner), Claude (autofix/onboarding code generation).

## MCP Server

AI assistant integration for Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible tools.

```bash
go install github.com/obtraceai/obtrace-mcp/cmd/mcp-obtrace@latest
mcp-obtrace --api-key=YOUR_KEY
```

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/mcp

## Billing & Plans

Plans: free, indie, startup, growth, scale.

Limits per plan: ingest bytes/mo, RCA/mo, autofix/mo, replay/mo, max services, max users, retention days.

Docs: https://docs.obtrace.ai/docs/features/billing

## Ingestion Protocols

- OTLP gRPC: port 4317
- OTLP HTTP: for telemetry ingestion
- REST API: external APIs
- Kafka/Redpanda: internal async streaming

## Security

- Gate1 (ingest-edge): auth, size/quota/rate limiting, billing gate, basic PII scrubbing
- Gate2 (workers): JSONPath/regex policy-based scrubbing per tenant
- All tokens encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM
- OAuth tokens auto-refreshed before expiry
- RBAC with tenant/project/app scoping
